content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] FS4 module and need to read IOs from an [product_name] HMI panel. Since I don't have access to the actual panel, I'm attempting to simulate the HMI. However, the displayed values are appearing as ####, and there is no communication with a [product_name] runtime advanced. The module is connected directly to my PC's LAN port. I followed the recommended steps for setting up the connection with a basic panel HMI, but the connection is not established. I am able to read the Memory Register of the [product_name] module using [product_name] 7.4 with modbus TCP/IP.

Hello, I recall an issue where the [product_name] simulation feature in [product_name] Basic did not work correctly when used with [product_name] version [version_no]. A physical HMI panel functions properly, but simulation has problems. This issue is resolved by updating the firmware from [product_name] [version_no] FS:05 to FS:06. More details and the update can be found on the [company_name] support portal under updates. Upgrading your module to FS:06 should fix this problem. Hope this information helps.
Hello, Please verify the PG/PC interface settings on your computer. Ensure that the correct Ethernet card is selected to allow communication through S7Online. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you for your support, [user_name]. Now I can access values in both simulation and [product_name] runtime. Firmware link: [url]

A firmware update was identified as the solution, enabling reliable HMI simulation and software-based communication.
